description: Returns a paginated list of company-level Project Status snapshots with optional filtering and sorting. With include_not_submitted=true and period IDs in filters[financial_period_id], the list also contains a "Not Submitted" row (approval_status not_submitted, null id) for each active project assigned to the budget view that has no snapshot in a filtered period that has started. With include_not_submitted=true and without filters[financial_period_id], filters[status_id] including -1 adds these rows for the current financial period. "Not Submitted" rows are omitted when filters[created_at] or filters[created_by_id] is supplied.

parameters.name: filters[status_id]
parameters.description: Filter snapshots by PSS custom status ID, e.g. "[3,4]". With include_not_submitted=true, include -1, e.g. "[3,-1]", to also match "Not Submitted" rows; without filters[financial_period_id] these ar...

parameters.name: filters[financial_period_id][]
parameters.description: Filter snapshots by financial period ID. Accepts one or more IDs. Pass the token `null` (or `nil`) as a value to match snapshots that have no financial period. Tokens and IDs can be combined — e.g....

parameters.name: filters[project_number][]
parameters.description: Filter snapshots by one or more project numbers

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description: Filter snapshots by created_at date range, inclusive

parameters.name: comparison_financial_period_id
parameters.description: ID of the financial period to use as the comparison baseline. When omitted, no comparison data is returned.

parameters.name: include_not_submitted
parameters.description: When true, also return "Not Submitted" rows for projects without a snapshot in a filtered financial period (or the current period when filters[status_id] includes -1 without filters[financial_perio...

parameters.name: comparison_budget_column_ids
parameters.description: Restrict comparison data to these budget column IDs. When omitted, comparison is returned for all columns.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort parameter. "Not Submitted" rows have no created_at or status, so they sort first when descending and last when ascending by those fields.

id.description: The ID of the snapshot. Null only for a "Not Submitted" row, returned only with include_not_submitted=true.

name.description: The name of the snapshot. Null only for a "Not Submitted" row, returned only with include_not_submitted=true.

approval_status.description: Approval state of the project status snapshot. Null for ad-hoc snapshots that have no approval workflow. not_submitted for a "Not Submitted" row, returned only with include_not_submitted=true: a pr...

created_by.description: The user who created the snapshot. Null only for a "Not Submitted" row, returned only with include_not_submitted=true.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the snapshot was created. Null only for a "Not Submitted" row, returned only with include_not_submitted=true.

currency_configuration.description: Currency configuration object, the currency for the snapshot

financial_period.description: The financial period associated with this snapshot. Null when the snapshot was not created within a financial period.

column_totals.description: Array of per-budget-column totals for the snapshot.
